meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'al (in al dente)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.trans: That your vegetables are supposed to be al dente.

meanings.note: Privative prefix 'бес-' ('without, -less', before voiceless consonants) (stem 'сердечный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('heartless').

examples.text: Человека на улицу ты бессердешная, Настя.
examples.trans: Throwing a man out on the street—you are heartless, Nastya.

examples.text: Сегодня у шефа очень бессердечный день в ресторане.
examples.trans: Today the chef is having a very heartless day at the restaurant.
